description: Telegram deterministic decision paths, the §14.5 command set, the CR-001 Telegram lifecycle commands and the chat-relay plumbing with the fail-closed Hermes tool-surface check (phase2-plan.md items 1-4; PLAN.md items 22-23 minus presentation). The visual presentation (decorated §14.4 card, diff paging, test-log views, golden cards) is FEAT-010, gated on CR-003; this FEAT keeps the Phase 1 cards.py renderer and keyboards.card_rows layout and adds only the deterministic flows behind the token purposes. Hermes is faked here (tests/fakes/fake_hermes.py); the real Hermes arrives in FEAT-007. Depends on FEAT-001..004 (approved).
steps: Item 1 (housekeeping, first commit): commit docs/review-phase1.json and docs/review-phase1.md (Phase 1 review round 6, APPROVED, 5 NITs assigned to FEAT-008) together with the Phase 2 plan artifacts docs/plan/phase2-plan.md, docs/plan/task-ossbot-v1/{task.json,context.json} and features/FEAT-005..011.json as 'docs(plan): Phase 1 review round 6 (APPROVED) and the Phase 2 plan'. Never stage docs/adr/0019-*, docs/plan/CR-003-*, docs/ux/**.

Item 2: add src/ossbot/gatekeeper/migrations/0002_phase2.sql (tables pending_input(id, kind CHECK IN ('changes','edit_title','edit_body','reject_other','edit_comment'), cid, approval_id, prompt_message_id, chat_id, created_at, expires_at, consumed_at) and chat_sessions(tg_user_id PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at)); register it in the db migrations runner. Write src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/pending_input.py (create on ForceReply send, 15 min TTL, match only a message whose reply_to_message.message_id == prompt_message_id in the owner chat, single consumption). In handlers.py add the purposes changes, edit_title, edit_body, clear_edits, reject_reason, give_up_fix, stop_watch, stop_watch_confirm (names from the ui_tokens comment in 0001_init.sql): Request changes -> ForceReply 'Describe the change (<= 4000 chars)' -> change_requests row + AWAITING_APPROVAL->CHANGES_REQUESTED via state_machine + old card edited 'superseded by change request'; Edit title/body (and edit_comment for comment/claim bodies) -> ForceReply with the current text quoted -> P1-4: run policy.check_text (confidentiality floor, secret patterns, disclosure, title 1-256 single line, body <= 60000) on the edited text and refuse with the reason BEFORE ApprovalService.set_text_override stores anything -> new card via ctx.on_approval_created, old approval invalidated; Clear my edits -> overrides NULL + new card; Reject -> reason keyboard [Not valuable] [Wrong approach] [Repo unsuitable (cooldown)] [Other…], Other -> ForceReply (<= 500 chars), Repo unsuitable -> repo_overrides.cooldown_until = now + 7 d; Give up on this fix / Stop watching (+confirm) per §9.12 transitions. Non-reply free text is handed to the chat relay hook (item 4). Tests: tests/telegram/test_pending_input.py, tests/telegram/test_edit_flows.py (edited body with a confidentiality-floor value or without the disclosure is refused and nothing is stored; edited title with a newline refused; wrong reply target ignored; expired prompt ignored; replayed token no state change).

Item 3: the remaining §14.5 commands in new modules src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/commands/{review.py,admin.py,lifecycle.py} imported by handlers.py like builtin: /queue (read; contributions grouped by state with one 'open card' button per pending approval -> /approve flow), /approve <cid> (read; N4: one transaction invalidates every ui_tokens row of the old card(s), resets armed->pending, re-sends the card as a NEW message, mints tokens only after send + body parts delivered, edits the old card 'moved to a newer message'; expired -> live checks re-run, fresh approval row), /reject <cid> [reason] (config, confirm), /reload (go: shows the config diff of POST /v1/config/reload dry form, confirm applies), /repos [filter] (read; per-repo Enable/Disable/Allow AI buttons are config + confirm, writing repo_overrides), /limits and alias /budget (read; limits + 24 h usage + per-role invocation counts from stage_runs), /logs <cid> [stage] (read; last 40 redacted lines + the log as a document), /newchat (read; chat_sessions.n += 1). CR-001: /drain (stop, immediate: ControlService.drain scope workers), /undrain (go, confirm: ControlService.up), /down (stop, immediate: gatekeeper writes /var/lib/ossbot/control/lifecycle-request {action:'down', scope:'workers', actor, ts, nonce}), /up (go, confirm: same request file with action 'up'). Root side: scripts/bin/ossbot-lifecycle (self-contained bash like scripts/bin/ossbot-resume: request owned by gatekeeper, regular file, <= 4 KiB, ts <= 5 min old, jq-validated, always consumed; 'down' runs /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/ossctl down --scope workers --kind graceful, 'up' runs ossctl up and is refused while killed), systemd/ossbot-lifecycle.path (PathExists=/var/lib/ossbot/control/lifecycle-request) + systemd/ossbot-lifecycle.service (root oneshot, TimeoutStartSec=300, TimeoutStopSec=150), both added to OSSBOT_ENABLE_UNITS in scripts/lib/services.sh. /status keeps the lifecycle + poll-health line and adds running stages, last anchor and kiro-cli/Hermes versions when known. setMyCommands from registry.menu() at bot start (if not already done in telegram/bot.py); outbox honours 429 retry_after (verify outbox.py; add if missing). Tests: tests/telegram/test_commands.py (every command, safety class enforced: go/config never act without the confirm tap; /approve rotation N4), tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_lifecycle.py (request file contents), tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py (new units), extend tests/system/test_lifecycle.sh with the Telegram path (trigger through the gatekeeper API as ossadmin operator: runner/hermes/sandboxd stopped, gatekeeper still active, then up).

Item 4: chat relay plumbing (§14.1, §15.1) in src/ossbot/gatekeeper/chat/{__init__.py,backend.py,hermes_api.py,hermes_surface.py,markdown.py}: ChatBackend protocol; HermesApiBackend (httpx to http://127.0.0.1:8642, bearer HERMES_API_KEY from the gatekeeper env, POST /v1/responses with X-Hermes-Session-Key tg-<uid>-<n>, GET /v1/capabilities at start, timeouts, no retries of a sent turn); hermes_surface.check() (GET /v1/toolsets parsed with extra='ignore', allowed {memory,todo_list,session_search} ∪ ossbot_*, bridge tools tool_search/tool_describe/tool_call forbidden, 404/schema mismatch/non-JSON -> unverifiable; drift or unverifiable -> relay disabled + ControlService soft kill reason hermes_tool_surface + Telegram alert listing the tools; connection refused/timeout -> 'Hermes is unavailable', no kill) run at gatekeeper start, hourly and before the first relayed message after a connection error; relay gate also requires /var/lib/ossbot/probes/hermes-kiro.json passed:true younger than 2 h (file absent -> relay disabled with reason, no kill); markdown.py = the minimal §14.3 converter on escaped text; replies rendered '🤖 ' + escaped text, no buttons, never parsed for commands, chunked <= 3900 with cards._chunks; ossbot_notify path keeps using api/notify.py. Wire handlers.on_message: commands -> registry; pending_input replies -> item 2; everything else (and /chat <text>) -> relay. Allowlist is a constant parameterised by tier so FEAT-009 can extend it. Tests: tests/fakes/fake_hermes.py (respx or a local ASGI app), tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_hermes_surface.py (the six §15.1 fakes: terminal -> kill; file/read_file -> kill; bridge tools -> kill; 404 -> kill; allowlist -> pass; allowlist with extra label/description/configured -> pass; plus connection refused -> no kill), tests/telegram/test_relay.py (Hermes output containing /approve, HTML, a t:<22> string renders as escaped text, no buttons, no command runs; relay disabled while the probe file is missing or stale).

Item 5: redeploy with powershell -NoProfile -File d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -Only provision, run the FEAT verification, then one LIVE read-only Telegram check through product code: send '/status'-equivalent FYI via the outbox (POST /v1/notify as ossadmin) and confirm delivery to the configured user only; record it in docs/VERIFICATION.md '## Phase 2 live checks'. Set this FEAT status completed, write findings (new purposes, request-file format, relay gate behaviour, anything FEAT-007/009/010 need), commit locally.
acceptance_criteria: DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram" passes, including test_pending_input.py, test_edit_flows.py, test_commands.py, test_relay.py and test_hermes_surface.py (AC 25)
P1-4: an Edit title/body whose text violates policy.check_text is refused with the reason and nothing is stored (set_text_override never called); proven by a test

CR-001: /drain, /undrain, /down (scope workers: runner, Hermes, sandboxd stopped, gatekeeper stays up) and /up work end to end; tests/system/test_lifecycle.sh passes with the Telegram-path case after redeploy; go-class commands act only after the confirm tap
Relay: Hermes text is always escaped, buttonless and never executed; surface drift or unverifiable surface soft-kills with reason hermes_tool_surface; Hermes down only disables the relay
ossbot-lifecycle.path is active after bootstrap; bootstrap re-run prints only 'unchanged'
